2493-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2493-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3678-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3678-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

225-1021-5414-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat.

728-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1052-4247-6553.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

240-4247-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

533-1605-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-1605-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Gratuitous Violence.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

880-3875-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

338-549-2685-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-549-2685-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-4871-5686-6887.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-4068-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1368-4068-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

104-5870-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5870-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

789-997-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-997-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
789-997-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

2034-4742-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

586-997-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-4091-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Aphetto Alchemist to gain all creature types.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2468-6587-6588-7068.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Infinite Guideline Station.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Ultimecia, Time Sorceress from exile to the battlefield.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

573-5449-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5449-5478-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

803-1429-4050-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-4050-5402.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

2060-2577-2921-3602.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2577-2921-3602.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1247-4289-4613-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1247-4289-4613-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding {1}.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Wylie Duke using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

222-629-2511-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

575-2921-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-2921-4319-5441.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

1353-1887-3323-4020.notablePrerequisites: Tevesh Szat and Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa are your commanders.
1353-1887-3323-4020.description:
Cast Tevesh Szat by paying {4}{B}, plus commander tax (if applicable).
Tevesh Szat enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Norn's Choirmaster triggers, proliferating, putting two loyalty counters on Tevesh Szat.
Activate Tevesh Szat's last loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, choosing to put it into the command zone.
Resolve the ability, putting Tevesh Szat and all other commanders from the command zone onto the battlefield and gaining control of all commanders.
Norn's Choirmaster triggers at least once, proliferating at least once; choose to put exactly two loyalty counters on Tevesh Szat.
Repeat from step 4.

224-1772-3861-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2758-4222-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Paradise Mantle attached to Grimoire Thief.
Grimoire Thief does not have summoning sickness.
2758-4222-4474.description:
Activate Grimoire Thief by tapping it, adding {U}.
Grimoire Thief triggers, exiling the top three cards of an opponent's library face down.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Grimoire Thief.
Repeat.

380-2232-4050-4081.description:
Cast Mothdust Changeling by paying {U}.
Mothdust Changeling enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Miirym.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Mothdust Changeling.
The Mothdust Changeling token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Mothdust Changeling from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mothdust Changeling token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

95-1861.notablePrerequisites: Optionally, you control an additional creature with power 2 or greater.
95-1861.description: Cast Cut Your Losses by paying its mana cost, causing an opponent to mill a number of cards equal to half their library, rounded down, times two due to Bruvac.
95-1861.notes: If the targeted opponent(s) has an odd number of cards in their library, they will have one card remaining. If they have an even number, they will mill their entire library. You can also pay the casualty cost to target two players.

654-1912-4257-4499.description:
Activate Emiel, exiling Golos and returning Golos to the battlefield.
Golos triggers, searching your library for a land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Repeat.

1013-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1013-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Hypervolt Grasp ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1168-1479-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
